notes: AstraZeneca acquired Fusion for ~$2.4B — $2.0B upfront ($21.00/share) plus a $0.4B CVR ($3.00/share) — its entry into targeted alpha therapy. Lead asset FPI-2265 is an actinium-225 alpha-emitter targeting PSMA, in Phase 2 for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC), positioned for the post-Lu-177 setting. Peak-sales estimate $1.2B is sell-side; EV/peak ~2.0x. Same Ac-225 alpha class as RayzeBio's RYZ101, different antigen (PSMA vs SSTR2).
selection_rationale: Second large-cap Ac-225 alpha-emitter acquisition, PSMA-targeted — the most-pursued radioligand antigen. Reinforces the Oncology · radiopharmaceutical cohort with an alpha-emitter at an earlier (Phase 2) stage.
source: AstraZeneca press release Mar 19 2024; Fusion SEC filings; sell-side peak-sales estimate (not company guidance).
